newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Paper products firm applies for Singapore listing.
newsitem.headline: Paper products firm applies for Singapore listing.

text.p: New Toyo International Holdings has applied for a listing on the Stock Exchange of Singapore, said a company spokeswoman said on Monday.
She declined to give further details or say whether the Singapore-based company had already received an approval from the exchange.
According to a report in the Straits Times, the company is one of the largest independent producers of laminated products and non-carbon paper in Southeast Asia.
It said the company has operations in Singapore as well as plants and offices in Malaysia, Hong Kong, Australia, Vietnam and China.
The Straits Times said the group made a pre-tax profit of Singapore $10.6 million in 1995.
